results.name: squad_member_candidate_desirability
results.evidence: Iterates data_iterator_next() entries whose field+0x34 is a valid object, keeps only those within 900 (30^2) squared units of a reference transform (object_get_node_local_transform), optionally checks a squad-visibility bitmap at global_scenario-linked DAT_00746f9c+0x14c and an exposure test via FUN_00505880(0x27,...), then scores each by distance/facing and returns the best object (out param) and its distance; called from FUN_00431680 (squad member slot resolver) as a candidate scorer, not a grenade routine as the pass-1 'grenade_throw_desirability' label suggested (no grenade string/callee present).
results.summary: Scans nearby datum-linked objects within 30 units, scores each by distance/facing/exposure, and returns the highest-scoring object and its distance to the caller (used to pick a squad-member candidate); param_1 selects a stricter LOS/visibility check, unaff_EBX carries an implicit starting object chain.

results.name: squad_try_activate_by_index
results.evidence: Validates an implicit starting-location index (in_AX) against *(global_scenario+0x468), calls squad_new_instance(in_AX,param_1) to obtain a squad_instance_index, immediately checks readiness via FUN_00430fc0 (squad_evaluate_regroup_decision-style check) and squad_despawn()s the instance if not ready, returning success/fail.
results.summary: Attempts to spawn and validate a squad from a scenario starting-location index, despawning it again if the freshly created squad fails its readiness check; the starting-location index arrives in an implicit AX register.

results.name: squad_get_status
results.evidence: Walks data_iterator_next() entries comparing field+2 (a squad definition index) to param_1 and derives a 1-4 status code from flag bytes at +4/+5/+6/+8, falling back to a secondary table at DAT_00880354 stride 0x10 when no live instance is found.
results.summary: Returns a numeric activation status (1-4, or a design-time fallback code) for the squad definition identified by param_1, preferring a live runtime squad instance.

results.name: squad_get_formation_index
results.evidence: Iterates data_iterator_next() entries matching an implicit definition index (unaff_BX) against field+2 and returns the stored value at field+0x48, or the sentinel 999 if no matching live squad instance exists.
results.summary: Looks up the formation-related field (+0x48) of the live squad instance matching an implicit squad-definition index (BX), returning 999 if none is active.

results.name: squad_destroy_all_instances
results.evidence: Walks data_iterator_next() matching field+2 against an implicit definition index (unaff_SI) and calls squad_despawn(-1,0,0) for every match.
results.summary: Force-despawns every live squad instance whose definition index matches an implicit register argument (SI).

results.name: squad_disable_respawn_for_definition
results.evidence: Walks data_iterator_next() matching field+2 against an implicit definition index (unaff_SI) and sets byte field+9 to 1 on every match, mirroring the respawn-disable byte pattern seen elsewhere in this batch.
results.summary: Sets a per-instance flag byte (+9) on every live squad instance of a given definition (implicit SI), most likely disabling further respawn.

results.name: squad_update_all
results.evidence: Zero-argument routine that walks every live squad instance via data_iterator_next(); for unplaced squads it periodically re-checks despawn eligibility via FUN_00430fc0 and, once placed, drives members through FUN_00431e70/FUN_00431d10 (placement readiness/activation) or squad_despawn()s the whole squad; no implicit registers are used, matching a per-tick top-level driver.
results.summary: Per-tick driver that iterates every live squad instance, periodically re-validates unspawned squads for despawn, and advances placed squads through member activation/placement or despawns them when finished.

results.name: squad_remove_member_reference
results.evidence: Walks data_iterator_next() squad instances and their member slot arrays (field+0x28+i*4) for entries equal to param_1; when the design squad's 'always destroy' flag (encounter record+0x20 bit0) is set it squad_despawn()s the whole squad, otherwise clears the matching member slot and its presence bit at +0x14.
results.summary: Removes an object reference (param_1) from every squad instance's member slot list, despawning the whole squad instead when its design record is flagged to always be destroyed on member loss.

results.name: squad_evaluate_regroup_decision
results.evidence: For a given squad_instance_index (param_1) resets a block of member-tracking fields, calls FUN_00431680 (squad_resolve_member_slot) per member slot to test retreat/regroup eligibility, may switch a member into custom-animation mode 0xc via actor_set_mode, and falls back to a global data_iterator_next() scan when no in-squad candidate qualifies; writes the result flag through param_2.
results.summary: Evaluates whether a squad instance should regroup/retreat by resolving each member slot's best candidate via squad_resolve_member_slot, returning a go/no-go flag through param_2.

results.name: squad_resolve_member_slot
results.evidence: For member slot param_1 of the squad named by implicit EAX, reads the slot's definition type from the design squad's +0x54 table; type 1 assigns a fixed unit directly, other types search nearby actors/units via actor_iterator_next or FUN_004326d0 and score each with FUN_00430fc0[sic]->FUN_004303f0 (proximity/facing/exposure desirability), formation-slot matching, and random tie-breaks, writing the winning object/type back through the squad instance record.
results.summary: Resolves one squad member slot to a concrete unit, either from a fixed design assignment or by scoring nearby candidate units/actors with a desirability function and formation-slot matching; the squad index is passed in EAX rather than as a formal parameter.

results.name: squad_activate_next_member
results.evidence: For a squad_instance_index carried in implicit EAX, validates the member-slot pointer at +0x48 against the design squad's member count and the presence bitmask at +0x14, then populates active-member bookkeeping fields (+0x4a/+0x4c/+0x4e/+0x50/+0x54/+0x58/+0x5c/+0x60) from the resolved slot data (the shape produced by squad_resolve_member_slot).
results.summary: Advances a squad instance to its next design-ordered member slot and fills in the runtime active-member bookkeeping fields from the previously resolved slot data; the squad index arrives in EAX.

results.name: squad_check_member_ready_to_place
results.evidence: For the squad instance in implicit EAX, on first evaluation (record+0x61==0) validates the active member's leader weapon-object chain, optionally stalls via FUN_00543e10/FUN_00543fc0 or queues a placement request via FUN_00560d00/FUN_00560f20, then gates on a countdown at +0x4c before returning a 'ready' byte from +99.
results.summary: Gates and eventually confirms whether the squad instance's currently-resolved member is ready to be placed into the world, handling a one-time leader/weapon validation and an optional countdown/queued-placement path.

results.name: weighted_random_pick_excluding_mask
results.evidence: Sums a strided float array (param_1/param_2 base+stride, count param_3) skipping indices whose bit is set in the bitmask param_4, then re-walks the array picking the index where a PRNG value (random_seed_global) scaled by the running total lands, returning -1 if the sum is non-positive.
results.summary: Performs a weighted-random selection over a strided float-weight array, excluding indices flagged in a bitmask, using the global PRNG state.

results.name: encounter_find_squad_by_name
results.evidence: Linearly scans an array (count at implicit-object+0x42c, entries at +0x430, stride 0xb0) with __strnicmp(name,param_1,0x20); the object base (unaff_ESI) and stride/offsets match the encounter/squad-design block referenced elsewhere (global_scenario+0x42c/+0x430).
results.summary: Finds the index of a design-time squad in the scenario's encounter/squad table whose name matches param_1 (case-insensitive, up to 32 chars).

results.name: squad_find_starting_location_by_name
results.evidence: Same __strnicmp linear-search pattern as encounter_find_squad_by_name but over a nested per-squad array (count at +0x80, entries at +0x84, stride 0xe8), matching the starting-location sub-table stride seen elsewhere (global_scenario/+0x430 +0x84 stride 0xe8).
results.summary: Finds the index of a starting location within a given squad's starting-location array whose name matches param_1.

results.name: squad_find_platoon_by_name
results.evidence: Identical __strnicmp linear-search pattern over yet another nested per-squad array (count at +0x8c, entries at +0x90, stride 0xac), distinct from the starting-locations array used by squad_find_starting_location_by_name.
results.summary: Finds the index of an entry (most likely a platoon) within a squad's secondary name-keyed sub-array matching param_1.

results.name: encounter_parse_squad_reference_string
results.evidence: Special-cases the string "none" (__stricmp) to -1, otherwise splits on the last '/' (_strrchr) and resolves the squad-name portion via FUN_00432200 (encounter_find_squad_by_name) and the remainder via FUN_00432260/FUN_004322c0 (starting-location/platoon lookups), packing the results into *param_1.
results.summary: Parses a 'squad/sub-entry' style scenario reference string into a packed squad+sub-index value, resolving each half by name through the squad/starting-location/platoon lookup helpers.

results.name: ai_reference_resolve
results.evidence: Decodes a packed reference (low 16 bits = squad index, top 2 bits of param_1 = a type selector, byte at bit 0x10 = sub-index), validates the squad index against global_scenario+0x42c, and writes a resolved squad/type/sub-index triple through an implicit EDX output pointer.
results.summary: Decodes a packed scenario ai-reference value into a validated (squad, type, sub-index) triple written through an implicit output pointer (EDX).

results.name: ai_reference_iterator_new
results.evidence: Decodes the same packed reference format as ai_reference_resolve but instead of a single index initializes a 5-field iterator record (squad index, type filter, current/max range) through an implicit output pointer (ECX), matching the iterator consumed by ai_reference_iterator_next.
results.summary: Initializes an iterator record over a squad's starting-location/platoon sub-entries from a packed ai-reference value, for use with ai_reference_iterator_next.

results.name: ai_reference_iterator_next
results.evidence: Advances the iterator record built by ai_reference_iterator_new (fields [3]/[4] as current/max index), optionally filtering entries by a type value stored in field [1] against the starting-location sub-array (stride 0xe8, offset+0x22), and returns a pointer into the platoon/spawn-point table (DAT_008802cc, stride 0x20).
results.summary: Yields successive filtered entries from an ai_reference_iterator_new iterator, returning a pointer into the runtime platoon table for each match.

results.name: actor_iterator_by_squad_new
results.evidence: Decodes a packed reference (squad index plus a 2-bit type selector) into an implicit iterator record's filter fields (ECX[1]/[2]) and, when the squad index is valid, kicks off enumeration via FUN_004369f0; consumed by actor_iterator_by_squad_next (FUN_004326d0) throughout this batch (23 callers).
results.summary: Initializes a filtered actor-enumeration-by-squad iterator from a packed ai-reference value, storing its state through an implicit ECX pointer.

results.name: actor_iterator_by_squad_next
results.evidence: Walks a linked list of actor records (0x724-stride, chained via field+0x2c through DAT_00880360) starting from the iterator state at implicit EDX+0x10/+0x14, filtering by squad index (+4) and formation slot (+8), matching field offsets +0x3a/+0x3c on the actor record; called 23 times alongside actor_iterator_by_squad_new.
results.summary: Advances the actor-by-squad iterator, returning the next actor record matching the squad/formation filter set up by actor_iterator_by_squad_new.

results.name: ai_reference_build_member_list
results.evidence: Allocates a root datum in DAT_0087a464 keyed by param_1, then iterates matching actors via actor_iterator_by_squad_new/next (FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0), adding a node per member (and per weapon-holding sub-object via field+0x1fc) into a second datum table (DAT_0087a468); this bucket/node pair is consumed by the several 'ai_reference_for_each_member_*' and 'squad_group_*' helpers later in this batch.
results.summary: Builds a bucket (DAT_0087a464) plus linked-node list (DAT_0087a468) of every actor/weapon-object reachable from a squad reference, returning the bucket's datum handle.

results.name: squad_trigger_starting_location_script
results.evidence: Resolves a packed starting-location reference (param_2, decoded the same way as ai_reference_resolve) down through the encounter table (global_scenario+0x430) and a tag-block cluster table (DAT_0087bc14) to find an actor_variant/object_type pair, then calls actor_new_and_attach_to_unit(...) followed by FUN_00435f00.
results.summary: Resolves a squad/starting-location reference to an actor-variant tag and spawns/attaches a new actor to unit param_1 there via actor_new_and_attach_to_unit.

results.name: ai_reference_for_each_member_trigger_script
results.evidence: Walks the bucket/node hash built by ai_reference_build_member_list (DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468, keyed by implicit EAX) and calls FUN_004328c0 (squad_trigger_starting_location_script) once per member payload.
results.summary: Iterates the member list previously built by ai_reference_build_member_list and calls squad_trigger_starting_location_script for each entry.

results.name: ai_reference_group_delete_actors_with_weapon
results.evidence: Walks the same DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468 bucket/node hash keyed by implicit ECX, and for each entry whose object record's field+500 (DAT_008603b0-indexed) is not -1, calls actor_delete(0).
results.summary: Iterates the member list built by ai_reference_build_member_list and deletes the associated actor for every member whose object has a non-empty field at offset +500 (likely a held weapon/child object reference).

results.name: squad_reference_dispatch
results.evidence: Decodes an encoded ai-reference (top 2 bits select type 0/1/2, low 16 bits = squad id, byte 2 = sub-index) using the same layout as ai_reference_resolve, then forwards the decoded squad/sub-index/type-2 value to FUN_00437510 with slightly different argument packing depending on the type.
results.summary: Decodes a packed ai-reference and forwards its squad/sub-index fields to an unidentified helper (FUN_00437510) with type-dependent argument packing.

results.name: squad_members_apply_callback
results.evidence: Guarded by an implicit handle (in_EAX), walks the squad-member iterator pair (FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0) calling FUN_004289c0(local_8,0) for each entry; local_8 is never explicitly initialized in the decompilation, suggesting it is populated as a side effect of the iterator calls.
results.summary: Invokes an unidentified per-member callback (FUN_004289c0) for every member of the squad referenced by an implicit handle.

results.name: squad_member_index_dispatch
results.evidence: Same encoded ai-reference decode as squad_reference_dispatch (top 2 bits select type), extracting the sub-index byte at offset 2 and always forwarding it to FUN_0042ab00, regardless of the decoded type branch.
results.summary: Decodes the sub-index field of a packed ai-reference and forwards it unconditionally to an unidentified helper (FUN_0042ab00).

results.name: squad_reference_resolve_actor
results.evidence: Decodes the packed ai-reference; for type==1 it scans the design squad's actor-placement array (encounter block global_scenario+0x430, stride 0xb0, sub-array +0x84 stride 0xe8) for a slot matching the sub-index and, on a resolved slot or type==2, forwards to FUN_00438f60; falls back to DAT_00880354 when the reference is unresolved.
results.summary: Resolves a packed squad/starting-location ai-reference to a concrete actor lookup via FUN_00438f60, searching the design squad's placement array for type-1 references.

results.name: squad_members_respawn_if_assigned
results.evidence: Walks the squad-member iterator (FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0) and, for members whose fields +0x18 or +0x24 are not -1 (an object or order already assigned), calls FUN_00432df0 (squad_member_respawn).
results.summary: Respawns every squad member that already has an assigned object or order, via squad_member_respawn.

results.name: squad_data_respawn_all
results.evidence: Uses the generic data_iterator_next() helper to walk a datum set (guarded by an implicit unaff_ESI handle) and calls FUN_00432df0 (squad_member_respawn) for every entry.
results.summary: Calls squad_member_respawn for every entry yielded by a generic datum iterator, gated on an implicit datum-set handle.

results.name: squad_member_respawn
results.evidence: For each squad member from the FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0 iterator with a valid object slot (field+0x34), writes state value 0x96 into the runtime squad record (DAT_008802c8 stride 0x6c, offset+0xe) and calls squad_activate(); also drains a secondary FUN_0043eb30 list calling actor_squad_react_to_grenade for each returned actor.
results.summary: Marks a squad's runtime state to trigger a respawn (via squad_activate) and notifies any actors pending grenade reaction (actor_squad_react_to_grenade) for the member currently under iteration.

results.name: squad_group_respawn_members
results.evidence: Uses the recurring bucket/node hash pair DAT_0087a464 (buckets) + DAT_0087a468 (node pool, 0xc-byte nodes: payload at +4, next at +8) keyed by implicit EAX to walk a member list and call FUN_00432df0 (squad_member_respawn) for each entry, matching the pattern used by ai_reference_for_each_member_* helpers.
results.summary: Respawns every member of the ai_reference_build_member_list member group via squad_member_respawn.

results.name: squad_design_members_set_flag_0x11
results.evidence: Walks a second iterator pair (FUN_004324f0/FUN_004325b0, the design-time ai_reference iterator, distinct from FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0) and sets byte field+0x11 to 1 for every yielded record, guarded by an implicit EAX handle.
results.summary: Sets a per-entry byte flag (+0x11) on every design-time record yielded by the ai_reference iterator (ai_reference_iterator_new/next).

results.name: squad_design_members_apply_callback
results.evidence: Same FUN_004324f0/FUN_004325b0 (ai_reference_iterator_new/next) iterator as squad_design_members_set_flag_0x11 but instead calls the unidentified FUN_00439270() unconditionally for every entry.
results.summary: Invokes an unidentified per-entry callback (FUN_00439270) for every record yielded by the design-time ai_reference iterator.

results.name: ai_reference_get_stat
results.evidence: Decodes param_1 exactly like the other packed ai-reference consumers (top 2 bits = squad/starting-location/platoon selector) and, depending on an implicit selector register (unaff_DI: 0/1/other), reads one of a pair of short counters plus an associated pointer from the matching runtime table (DAT_008802c8/DAT_008802c4/DAT_008802cc), writing them out through param_2/param_3.
results.summary: Reads a selected statistic (current count, max count, or their difference) and an associated pointer for a squad/starting-location/platoon reference, returning them through the count value and two output parameters.

results.name: squad_starting_location_range_in_use
results.evidence: Uses the squad record (DAT_008802c8, stride 0x6c) field+8 as a base index into the starting-location array (DAT_008802c4, stride 0x10) and, for the range decoded by FUN_00432420 (ai_reference_resolve), returns true as soon as any entry's leading byte is non-zero.
results.summary: Checks whether any starting-location slot in the range described by a decoded ai-reference is already marked in-use (leading byte non-zero).

results.name: squad_starting_location_range_clear
results.evidence: Same squad+starting-location addressing as squad_starting_location_range_in_use (DAT_008802c8 stride 0x6c, DAT_008802c4 stride 0x10) but writes 0 into the leading byte of every entry in the decoded range.
results.summary: Clears the in-use byte for every starting-location slot in the range described by a decoded ai-reference.

results.name: squad_starting_location_range_mark_used
results.evidence: Identical addressing to squad_starting_location_range_clear but writes 1 instead of 0 into the leading byte of each starting-location entry in range.
results.summary: Marks every starting-location slot in the decoded ai-reference range as in-use (leading byte set to 1).

results.name: squad_starting_location_range_set_reserved
results.evidence: Same squad/starting-location range walk as the other range_* helpers but sets the byte at offset+1 (rather than +0) to 1 for every entry in range.
results.summary: Sets a second per-slot byte flag (offset+1, likely 'reserved') to 1 for every starting-location slot in the decoded range.

results.name: squad_starting_location_range_set_enabled
results.evidence: Same range walk again, writing a bool at offset+2 equal to (param_1 == 0), i.e. an externally supplied flag inverted into a per-entry boolean.
results.summary: Sets a third per-slot boolean flag (offset+2) for every starting-location slot in the decoded range, based on the inverse of param_1.

results.name: squad_find_matching_actor_variant_member
results.evidence: Iterates a design squad's actor-placement array via the ai_reference_iterator_new/next pair (FUN_004324f0/FUN_004325b0), resolving each candidate's actor_variant/parent tag through DAT_0087bc14 and preferring, in priority order, an exact slot-index match (param_1/param_4), an exact actor_variant tag match (param_3), a parent-tag match (param_2), a same-parent-tag-id match, then any unused slot.
results.summary: Finds the best-matching member slot in a design squad's placement array for a requested actor_variant/parent tag pair, preferring exact matches and falling back to slot-index or 'any' matches.

results.name: squad_reassign_members_between_squads
results.evidence: Takes a destination squad (param_1) and source squad (implicit EDX); for each design member resolves the current actor_variant tag via DAT_0087bc14 and squad_find_matching_actor_variant_member (FUN_004333d0), then reassigns matching live actors and vehicle-boarding references from source to destination squad IDs, broadcasting an ai_communication_broadcast event and calling FUN_0042bbb0/FUN_00435f00 to finalize.
results.summary: Reassigns every applicable actor, weapon holder and vehicle passenger from a source squad to a destination squad, remapping member slot indices via squad_find_matching_actor_variant_member and optionally broadcasting a squad-change AI communication event.

results.name: unit_reassign_actor_squad_member
results.evidence: Resolves a unit's actor via the object header table (DAT_008603b0) reading fields +500/+0x1f8 (actor index), computes whether the actor's current squad (implicit ECX) equals param_1, resolves a replacement member slot via squad_find_matching_actor_variant_member (FUN_004333d0), and on change calls FUN_004290f0 followed optionally by FUN_00423600.
results.summary: Reassigns a single unit's associated actor to a new squad member slot (param_1's squad), using squad_find_matching_actor_variant_member to pick the destination slot and optionally raising a follow-up notification (FUN_00423600).

results.name: squad_group_reassign_members
results.evidence: Walks the DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468 bucket+node hash keyed by implicit ECX, resolving each node as an object via object_list_get_first-style header lookups against DAT_008603b0, and for units/bipeds (flags bit0/1 set) calls FUN_00433970 (unit_reassign_actor_squad_member) both for the unit and any occupants chained through field+0x118/+0x114, then finalizes with FUN_0042bbb0/FUN_00435f00.
results.summary: Reassigns every unit (and vehicle occupant) in an ai_reference member group to a new squad by calling unit_reassign_actor_squad_member on each.

results.name: actor_type_compare_and_notify
results.evidence: Compares param_1 against an implicit register value (in_AX), special-casing the value 1 as a wildcard and requiring exact equality for values 2 and 5, then reports the boolean result via FUN_0045be50.
results.summary: Compares two actor-type-like values (one implicit) with a wildcard rule and forwards the boolean match result to an unidentified reporting helper (FUN_0045be50).

results.name: squad_investigate_nearby_objects
results.evidence: Gets the calling object's position via object_try_and_get(3)/object_get_position, calls FUN_0056a310 to gather nearby objects into a local buffer, sorts them by (flag, distance) with _qsort against a named comparator (object_sort_by_flag_then_distance), then iterates the squad-member list (FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0) queuing each via FUN_0040e260, stopping early on a flagged object unless param_3 overrides it.
results.summary: Gathers nearby objects around the calling object, sorts them by a flag-then-distance rule, and dispatches squad members to investigate them in order, optionally stopping at the first flagged object.

results.name: squad_count_type9_members
results.evidence: Walks the actor_iterator_next() list counting entries whose type field (+0x6c) equals the constant 9 and whose group field (+0x9c) equals param_1, with no implicit registers used.
results.summary: Counts live actors of a fixed type code (9) belonging to the squad/group identified by param_1.

results.name: squad_members_update_weapon_state
results.evidence: Zero-argument routine walking the squad-member iterator (FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0); for each member unit it resolves the object header (DAT_008603b0) and, when a held weapon slot differs, reparents the weapon object via object_get_node_local_transform/matrix4x3_multiply/object_set_position_and_orientation, clears/sets light-attachment and animation state (unit_try_set_animation_state, unit_set_custom_animation), and updates bookkeeping fields (+0xc9/+0xca/+0xcb/+0xcc) on both the old and new holder objects.
results.summary: For every squad member, keeps the held/attached weapon object's transform, animation state and light attachments synchronized with its current holder, reparenting it between units when the held-weapon slot changes.

results.name: squad_members_set_combat_status
results.evidence: Walks the squad-member iterator guarded by an implicit handle (in_EAX); for param_1==0 raises an actor's status field (DAT_00880360 stride 0x724, offset+0x6a) from 0 to 2, otherwise resets +0x6a/+0x6c to 0 and calls FUN_00427e00/FUN_00429000/actor_set_units_active.
results.summary: Raises or clears a combat-alertness status field on every squad member's actor record, reactivating the member's units when clearing.

results.name: squad_group_set_combat_status
results.evidence: Same status-field manipulation as squad_members_set_combat_status (offset+0x6a/+0x6c on the DAT_00880360 actor record) but applied to every actor reachable through the DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468 member-group hash, including chained vehicle occupants via field+0x118/+0x114.
results.summary: Applies the same combat-alertness status update as squad_members_set_combat_status, but to an entire ai_reference member group (including vehicle occupants) instead of a single squad's iterator.

results.name: squad_group_actors_set_flag_0x400
results.evidence: Walks the DAT_0087a464/DAT_0087a468 group hash resolving each node to an actor via the inlined datum_get-style pattern against DAT_008603b0, then sets or clears bit 0x400 of the actor flags field at offset+0x204 depending on param_1.
results.summary: Sets or clears bit 0x400 of the actor flags field for every actor in an ai_reference member group.

results.name: squad_group_actors_set_flag_0x800
results.evidence: Identical structure to squad_group_actors_set_flag_0x400 but toggles bit 0x800 of the same actor flags field at offset+0x204.
results.summary: Sets or clears bit 0x800 of the actor flags field for every actor in an ai_reference member group.

results.name: squad_members_face_default_direction
results.evidence: For eligible squad members (no active order, or idle per FUN_0055aa20) with a valid parent object, looks up a facing angle from the design squad actor array (stride 0xe8, offset+0xd4, indexed by a starting-location index from squad_pick_random_starting_location) and applies it via fcos/fsin into object_set_position_and_orientation, followed by object_reset_velocity_and_wake and actor_movement_action_stop.
results.summary: Snaps idle squad members' orientation to the facing angle recorded at a randomly chosen starting location and stops their movement.

results.name: squad_members_update_grenade_state
results.evidence: Zero-argument walk of the squad-member iterator converting unit stat fields (+0xd8/+0xdc) into boolean floats at (+0xe0/+0xe4) on the held-weapon object, and, for weapons with a grenade-type field (+0x180 in the tag data via DAT_0087bc14), advances a per-grenade-type consumption counter using the global PRNG (random_seed_global) to pick a target count in a designer-specified range.
results.summary: Updates each squad member's held-weapon boolean trigger-state floats and, for grenade-capable actor variants, randomly advances a per-type grenade usage counter toward a designer-specified target range.

results.name: squad_members_clear_search_target
results.evidence: Zero-argument function walking the squad-member iterator and setting a 16-bit search-target-type field at offset+0x1d4 to 0 for every member, matching the sibling 'set_search_target_point/area' helpers that write the same field to 1/2.
results.summary: Clears the search-target-type field on every squad member, cancelling any active point/area search order.

results.name: squad_members_set_search_target_point
results.evidence: Same offset+0x1d4 field as squad_members_clear_search_target but sets it to 1 and also writes a 4-byte payload from an implicit register (unaff_ESI) into offset+0x1d8, matching a 'point' search-target variant next to the 'clear' (0) and 'area' (2) variants.
results.summary: Sets every squad member's search-target type to 'point' (1) and stores an implicit point/handle value (ESI) into the associated payload field.

results.name: squad_members_set_search_target_area
results.evidence: Same field as squad_members_clear_search_target/squad_members_set_search_target_point (offset+0x1d4) set to 2 with no associated payload write and no implicit registers, matching a parameterless 'area' search-target variant.
results.summary: Sets every squad member's search-target type field to 'area' (2).

results.name: squad_members_set_flag_0x1cb
results.evidence: Pure single-char-parameter function (no implicit registers) walking the squad-member iterator and writing a bool at offset+0x1cb equal to (param_1 == 0) for every member.
results.summary: Sets a per-member boolean flag (offset+0x1cb) on every squad member to the inverse of param_1.
